name_reason: Follows convention fd2_<descriptor>; accurately describes behavior (cast a screen-wide radial spell visual followed by a palette-flash fade-in). No address residue, no misleading element. Body and 6 callers (ch22/23/27/28/30 init/end cinematics) confirm: full-screen 9-frame growing shockwave + 500ms hold + 0x40-step palette fade-in.
purpose: BOSS / END-CHAPTER screen-wide spell visual: full-screen radial shockwave expanding over 9 frames, a long hold, then a palette-flash fade-in; used by ultimate/dragon-breath style spells and chapter init/end cinematics.
logic_summary: Preloads the status SFX bank, mallocs a 0x25680 (150KB) backdrop snapshot and composites the battle tile map into it, plays the boss-spell SFX, then runs a 9-frame growing-shockwave loop (frame_iter 9->1): each frame restores the backdrop into the large game-state buffer, renders a filled circle-band (sprite picked from the self-relative tile-anim table) at the epicenter screen pixel pos with the current radius, blits the composed buffer to the mode-13h framebuffer (0xA0504), grows radius by radius_increment, and delays 5. After freeing the snapshot and a 500ms hold, it runs a palette flash fade-in (brightness 0->0x3E step 2, delay 4 each), then re-arms the status SFX bank. Epicenter tile coords are scaled to screen pixels (tile*0x18 + 0xC / +0x10).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_screen_wide_spell_with_fade(uint param_1, uint param_2, uint param_3, int epicenter_tile_x)
